description: Ponte - DER 2025 (Minas Gerais) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Obra destinada a permitir que uma via que transponha um obstáculo líquido ou promover ligação entre dois pontos separados por um gradiente de declividade acentuada. Fonte: Departamento de Edificações e Estradas de Rodagem de Minas Gerais - DER/MG. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Ponte, DER-MG, DNIT, Minas Gerais, transportation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
